The
Zahrawi Group
is
a major medical device and healthcare solutions provider in the GCC region
(operating across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Bahrain, and Oman). While they specialize in clinical, surgical, and cardiovascular diagnostic equipment from global brands like Medtronic, they do not typically distribute consumer-grade smartwatches, sleep trackers, or generic retail wellness wearables.
www.zahrawigroup.com
However, they actively handle clinical-grade and remote cardiac monitoring solutions. Notably, they partnered with AppSens to introduce the ECG247 clinical cardiac monitoring system in Saudi Arabia, bridging professional remote diagnostics and patient care infrastructure.
www.zahrawigroup.com
Zahrawi Group Focus Areas
Surgical & Cardiovascular:
Advanced hospital instrumentation, structural heart, and neuromodulation tools.
Diagnostic & Lab:
Hematology, biochemistry, molecular diagnostics, and analytical systems.
Cardiac Remote Monitoring:
Clinical patch-based diagnostic systems (such as ECG247) implemented through regional healthcare networks.
www.zahrawigroup.com
If you are looking for
specific patient monitoring equipment, cardiac patches, or regional product availability
via Zahrawi Group, please let me know your
exact location or clinical requirement
so I can provide the right contact or technical details.
